selection_rule: First XML entry in each TestName group, in source order. Selection uses metadata only, not prediction errors.
model_provenance: HEM uses upstream defaults. Saha-Zuber/Bestion is the unchanged closure selection in upstream inputs/models.inp TUTORIAL2D. Remaining coefficients are upstream defaults. No fitting to these measurements.
calibration_membership: No coefficients are fitted in this campaign. Historical overlap of selected data with closure development is unknown; these cases are not claimed as independent holdout validation. NUTHOS15's calibrated MRM cases TestID22 and35 are not selected.

acceptance.experimental: Descriptive comparison only. No uncertainty-qualified pass/fail threshold; combined experimental, digitization and input uncertainty is incomplete.

reported_void_error_bound.interpretation: NUREG/IA-0025 states absolute void-fraction error less than 0.04 for all tests; confidence/distribution and digitization uncertainty are not established. Not a total validation tolerance.

acceptance.sensitivity_basis: Predeclared numerical screening goals: mesh 5% and iteration/pseudo-time 0.5% of reported 0.04 absolute void error. These are sensitivity goals, not estimates of numerical uncertainty or asymptotic convergence.
acceptance.point_policy: Preserve all source measurements, including negative digitized void values with flags. No clipping or extrapolation. Every unavailable or out-of-domain point is listed with its exclusion reason. Quality observations remain in equilibrium-quality coordinates; do not infer measured elevation.
acceptance.relative_error_policy: Do not compute relative void error near zero; report signed error, bias, MAE and RMSE in dimensionless void fraction and explicitly labelled percentage points.
acceptance.aggregation_policy: Report every attempted case/model/grid and every exclusion. Aggregate errors only within a named coordinate/model population, retaining convergence and physical status. An apparent fit cannot override failed checks.
